validation: Godot import: no SCRIPT ERROR or Parse Error
Headless --scenario=naval seed 3: exit 0, no script errors
Off-screen renders on Low, Medium, High and Ultra water, and gl_compatibility on High and Low: no shader or script errors

Follow-up matched shoreline: 60 frames per revision at 15 fps / 30 Hz simulation; 1280x396 VP9 comparison, 5.067 s with brief endpoint holds; full decode and beginning/action/result sampled-frame review passed.

Follow-up higher river: 60 frames, 640x360 VP9, 5.067 s with brief endpoint holds; full decode and representative frame review passed. Naval renders report no resource/script/shader errors; scenery-water regression test passes after asset recovery.
limitations: Reflections show only what is on screen and opaque; flames and smoke are not mirrored.
GPU timings were taken on a machine shared with other Godot runs; spreads of 0.3 to 1.6 ms.
The stills predate the reflection hit-validation follow-up; they do not validate that change.
Hit validation adds an initial depth lookup and a refined-hit lookup, and rejected candidates can continue marching. No same-scene GPU cost has been measured for this follow-up.

Follow-up motion uses Godot 4.7 Compatibility on Mesa llvmpipe in an actual Xorg window at 640x360 per view; High water, reduced shadows and AA disabled. Forward+ remains unavailable. The sparse cloud checkout cannot run the full website disclosure/media-control review.
The higher river clip is current-build-only; flow lanes are faint. Neither clip establishes a true horizon view or Forward+ rendering quality.
